definitions: The hollow between a woman's breasts, especially as revealed by a low-cut garment.
A sharp division or split between groups or sets of ideas.
The tendency of a crystal or rock to split along definite crystalline planes.
The division of cells in the early embryo.
examples: A dress with a plunging cleavage.
The deep cleavage between the two political parties.
The mineral exhibits perfect basal cleavage.
The first cleavage of the zygote.
